title: StorSafe Instance
description: Everything about one appliance. Pick the server at the top.

targets.expr: label_replace(storsafe_up{server="$server"}, "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_failover_status{server="$server"} == 1, "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(storsafe_check_success{server="$server"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(count(storsafe_physicaldevice_online{server="$server"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(count(storsafe_dedupe_repository_disk_online{server="$server"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(storsafe_events_total{server="$server",severity=~"error|critical"}[24h])) or vector(0), "k", "5", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_time_offset_seconds{server="$server"}, "k", "6", "", "") or label_replace(time() - storsafe_check_last_success_timestamp_seconds{server="$server",check="version"}, "k", "7", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Health
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Collected: Time since this appliance was last collected.

targets.expr: label_replace(100 * sum(storsafe_storagepool_used_bytes{server="$server"}) / sum(storsafe_storagepool_size_bytes{server="$server"}), "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(sum(storsafe_storagepool_size_bytes{server="$server"}) - sum(storsafe_storagepool_used_bytes{server="$server"}), "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace((sum(storsafe_storagepool_size_bytes{server="$server"}) - sum(storsafe_storagepool_used_bytes{server="$server"})) / clamp_min(deriv(sum(storsafe_storagepool_used_bytes{server="$server"})[30d:1h]), 1) / 86400, "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_storage_threshold_percent{server="$server"}, "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(100 * storsafe_virtualized_disk_used_bytes{server="$server"} / storsafe_virtualized_disk_size_bytes{server="$server"}, "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_dedupe_repository_info{server="$server"}, "k", "5", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Capacity
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Days until full (30d trend): Free space divided by the 30-day growth rate. Shows a very large number while usage is flat or falling; needs several days of data to settle.

panels.title: Reclamation / prune
panels.description: Status from the API (idle/running/failed). Times are tracked by the collector, to one collector interval.

targets.expr: label_replace(storsafe_replication_suspended{server="$server"}, "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_replication_queue_jobs_total{server="$server",queue="classic"}, "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_replication_queue_jobs_total{server="$server",queue="unique"}, "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(time() - (storsafe_unique_replication_oldest_job_start_timestamp_seconds{server="$server"} > 0), "k", "3", "", "") or label_replace(min(time() - storsafe_replica_newest_replicated_timestamp_seconds{server="$server"}), "k", "4", "", "") or label_replace(sum(storsafe_replica_tapes_not_replicated_within{server="$server",age="24h"}), "k", "5", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Replication
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Newest replica age: Time since the most recently updated replica tape held here.

panels.title: Recent warnings, errors and criticals
panels.description: The 20 newest non-informational events. The full log is archived daily under events\ on the monitoring host.

targets.expr: label_replace(storsafe_collector_info, "k", "0", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_collector_last_run_timestamp_seconds * 1000, "k", "1", "", "") or label_replace(count(storsafe_check_success{server="$server"} == 0) or vector(0), "k", "2", "", "") or label_replace(storsafe_collect_duration_seconds{server="$server"}, "k", "3", "", "")

options.defaultContent:
Collector
No data
Prometheus returned nothing for this section.

panels.description: Package version: Version of the installed StorSafe monitoring package (VERSION file in the install folder).
